title: 数理マネジメント
subtitle: Operations Research and Management Science
educationalGoal: This course deals with quantitative analysis from a business perspective. Students will learn to: (1)conduct quantitative analyses based on the methods of operations research. (2)make choices based on mathematical methods.
advice: This is a basic course in operations research. Students will learn the theoretical foundations for the various mathematical models of operations research and will acquire practical skills to analyze and plan through exercises using Microsoft Excel. We will cover the following topics: 1) Graphs and tables for business data. 2) Mathematical estimation using the multiple regression analysis. 3) Simulation 4) Optimization Students are required to bring their laptop computer, with Microsoft Excel installed, to every class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain problems from a mathematical viewpoint.
Be able to solve problems using mathematical tools such as Microsoft Excel.
Be able to construct mathematical models of complex problems in business.
Be able to propose effective solutions to business problems based on mathematical methods.
